# Results
Apple Inc. FY2026 revenue was $478.8 billion against $416.2 billion in the prior year, a change of +15.1%.
# Profitability
Operating income was $158.1 billion (33.0% of revenue); net income was $132.2 billion.
# Cash flow
Operating cash flow was $145.1 billion.
# Source
All figures are from the 10-K filed 2026-11-03. Check each against the filing before use.
